# OxY — systems & infrastructure engineer

> Portfolio of OxY, an anonymous systems & infrastructure engineer: selected
> work, experience and credentials. Credibility artifact for recruiters and
> potential collaborators.

OxY is a systems & infrastructure engineer, anonymous by choice — the work is
the résumé. Apprentice Site Reliability Engineer at a CAC40 software group
(EMEA HQ), building personal AI/agent infrastructure on the side. Open to
internships, consulting, and infra/security/AI work — remote or relocation.

## Experience

- 2023 — now · Site Reliability Engineer (apprentice), CAC40 software group,
  EMEA HQ. Global disaster-recovery orchestration across 200+ applications
  (+25% test coverage, incl. systems driving €1B+ revenue); enterprise risk
  analysis re-engineered with Python + ML clustering over 500+ platforms
  (ISO 27001/SOC2); zero-trust AWS Glacier backups with 4h RTO; Grafana
  observability pipelines feeding executive dashboards.
- Summer 2024 · IT Operations (intern), same group, North America HQ.
  IT asset lifecycle automation (−30% processing time), secure provisioning
  and decommissioning (BitLocker, data sanitization), cross-domain Active
  Directory incident resolution.
- 2023 · Business Developer, IT consulting firm. 10+ qualified CAC40
  opportunities in AI/ML, cybersecurity and cloud; CRM framework for ~5,000
  prospects.

## Selected work

- swapaws.app (https://swapaws.app) — full-stack P2P barter platform; NLP
  pipeline parsing unstructured buy/sell text into structured listings.
- PAI — self-hosted personal AI infrastructure: agent runtime, persistent
  entity memory, kanban orchestration, semantic search.
- Alpha Finder (https://alpha.devprocore.com) — automated early-signal
  tech-watch pipeline.
- Homelab & SIEM/XDR — docker-first homelab: Wazuh SIEM/XDR, mesh VPN,
  Nextcloud, Vaultwarden, everything as code.
- ML threat detection — network-traffic threat detection with scikit-learn,
  98% accuracy on benchmark datasets.
- Cryptography — symmetric cipher built on Prim's spanning-tree algorithm
  (C/C++).
